title: Separate fixed-N confidence from optional-stopping and tuning effects
statement: For a frozen sampler and iid trials, the source gives rational-grid binomial upper endpoints checked by integer CDF arithmetic, not Capital execution. Zero aborts at N=1000 has supplied fixed-99% upper .004595; N=30 only .142305 and N=5000 .000921. At predetermined checkpoints j, spending eta/[j(j+1)] unions to eta. Arbitrarily adaptive sample-count checking instead spends across every n, eta/[n(n+1)], or uses another valid time-uniform method. Distinct tuned configurations need confidence allocation or fresh independent final holdout; same-data tuning does not inherit this coverage.

evidence.quote: ## Abort estimation usable with optional stopping
evidence.range_scope: Whole user-supplied proof and research-code archive at its declared scope; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Basis input and complete computational-basis output of an open even square grid. Four disjoint matching layers cycle horizontal-even, horizontal-odd, vertical-even and vertical-odd. At each actual pair independently: D=(3I+4iZZ)/5 with probability 1-r-epsilon, QD with Q=(12I-5iXX)/13 and probability epsilon, or trace both qubits and replace by I/4 with probability r. Categories are state-independent; old reset outcomes, fresh preparation bits and all classical control are retained in the proof. Exact input, correct conditional physical instruments, normalized approximate states, canonical Schmidt weights relative to each precompression state, complete records and outcome-dependent control. Additional arithmetic/gate errors require separate bounds; adaptive representation choices are transcript-defined identities with correct physical-label maps.
provides: For a frozen sampler and iid trials, the source gives rational-grid binomial upper endpoints checked by integer CDF arithmetic, not Capital execution. Zero aborts at N=1000 has supplied fixed-99% upper .004595; N=30 only .142305 and N=5000 .000921. At predetermined checkpoints j, spending eta/[j(j+1)] unions to eta. Arbitrarily adaptive sample-count checking instead spends across every n, eta/[n(n+1)], or uses another valid time-uniform method. Distinct tuned configurations need confidence allocation or fresh independent final holdout; same-data tuning does not inherit this coverage.
assumptions: Record-weighted full-output error does not bound arbitrarily postselected rare conditional states. Raw noncanonical singular-value loss is insufficient. Equal local SVD tolerances do not imply equal total error across representations. Dynamic outcome-dependent ordering may invalidate a flags-only future-operation count. A finite observed abort rate is not an upper bound without the specified confidence method and frozen independent sampling. Source-reported exact confidence arithmetic is not an independent audit. No efficient-rank distribution, general noisy-circuit sampler or speed advantage is established.
costs: Complete user-supplied 402,894-byte original archive 3152a714, all 75 members and its 71-entry source manifest preserved. Byte-integrity checks only; no Capital scientific code, verifier, replay, benchmark, native/model query, source recovery or independent proof audit. Reproduction instructions inside the archive are source content, not new user instructions. All existing source/access/transfer holds persist. No inferred producer model, novelty, physical device, general scalability or North Star claim. Every routed-gate, MPO, ordering, cleanup or other Schmidt compression contributes its normalized sqrt(discarded weight). Exact QR, absorption and relabeling still cost arithmetic/runtime. Rank growth may be exponential; fixed caps introduce abort probability. Whole original code/data is shared with the exact-grid source family rather than treated as independent corroboration. No new MPS replay, confidence-arithmetic execution or benchmark.
contract.units: Quantum full-output total variation, trace distance with factor one half, exact integer bit operations, explicitly paid circuit slots, storage and stated finite statistical confidence.
obstruction: Implement any later sampler with correct instruments and normalized loss/cost accounting, then independently qualify its full error and resource behavior at an explicit model and confidence scope. General useful rank/tail bounds remain open. This card is mathematical capital, not authority to run source reproduction commands, acquire held materials or start new research.

review.scope: Supplied internal proof at its stated model, record, arithmetic and confidence assumptions; not independently verified. Earlier/source-standard machinery and shared identities count once. Scientific checks are supplied author records, not Capital execution.
